answer: A payout is split so that 30% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The ripple schedule is applied in ferrous and pearl makes public each instalment. An adversary as a result cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4723 identities would post 2681 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
